principles: Terminal cleanup must not create new filesystem residue after reporting success.
Activity logs are runtime audit breadcrumbs and should move to the surviving main repo if the invoking worktree disappears.
Regression should exercise the public story_advance DONE path rather than only private helpers.
drivers: writeLog runs after handlers finish, so story_advance DONE can delete the captured root before final activity append.
resolveMainRootFromWorktreeRoot is available before cleanup while the linked worktree .git file still exists.
worktree-authority-smoke already has a synthetic DONE-ready story fixture with delivery/test evidence.

options.name: explicit-main-root-fallback-plus-e2e-regression
pros: Robust against deleted cwd/root after DONE cleanup
Proves behavior through real story_advance DONE
cons: Small cli-engine orchestration change plus test fixture assertions

options.name: flush-activity-before-worktree-remove
cons: Changes command logging ordering and may miss final success/failure status

options.name: doctor-only-repair
cons: Leaves users with recurring residue and does not prevent the bug

rationale: Capture the main repo fallback before story_advance DONE can remove the worktree, use it only when the command root disappears, and add an end-to-end DONE smoke assertion that the removed worktree directory stays absent and activity logs land in main.

preMortem.scenario: Fallback points at the story worktree instead of main
preMortem.trigger: The fallback is resolved after the worktree directory has already been removed
preMortem.mitigation: Derive main root before deletion and assert main .koala/activity.jsonl receives the story_advance record

preMortem.scenario: Test only checks git worktree registry
preMortem.trigger: A regression leaves a physical orphan directory but git worktree list is clean
preMortem.consequence: Doctor still reports orphanDirs even though tests pass
preMortem.mitigation: Assert existsSync(worktreePath) is false after CLI exit

preMortem.trigger: Changing done-effects removal behavior instead of activity log routing
preMortem.consequence: DONE can leave real worktree residue or delete unsafe paths
preMortem.mitigation: Do not change done-effects removal logic or DONE gate rows
